verdict.rationale: WezTerm's docs claim true color and dynamic color schemes and show changing the color scheme via config, which hot-reloads automatically. That covers applying color schemes. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic light/dark mode switching, so only part of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic light/dark (system appearance) switching, detailed docs on the theme/color-scheme catalog, hands-on corroboration of theming.
